description: Storyhook — AI-native project management for coding agents.

plugins.name: story
plugins.description: AI-native project management for coding agents. `/story do <id>` dispatches a ready story to a fresh plan-mode Claude session in a new tmux window + per-story git worktree; `/story work`, `/story context`, and friends cover the rest of the session lifecycle. Proactive story tracking, session handoffs, and dependency-aware task selection via the storyhook CLI.
